job.title: Senior QA / QC Engineer — Wroclaw
job.description:
Senior QA / QC Engineer —Wroclaw

Location: Wroclaw(on-site) · Team: Quality Assurance (Engineering) · Reports to: QA Lead · Contract: permanent employment contract, full-time

About EC Markets and the role

EC Markets is an FCA-regulated FX and CFD brokerage. Our engineering team builds and runs our investing and trading app: a React Native / Expo app on iOS, Android and web, backed by a Java Spring Boot API on AWS that connects trading, custody, identity verification, payments and market-data platforms.

We are looking for a Senior QA / QC Engineer to help set the quality bar on a fast-moving mobile product. You will test new features and release candidates across iOS and Android, build and extend test automation running in CI/CD, and make release and production checks clear and repeatable.

What you will be doing

Test automation

  • Build and maintain mobile UI automation (iOS and Android), API test suites and performance and load tests.
  • Run automated suites in CI/CD against stable test environments.
  • Build automated regression into each sprint so it runs on every release candidate.

Release quality

  • Carry out functional and exploratory testing of new work, plus smoke and full regression for each release candidate.
  • Provide written evidence for release go / no-go decisions.
  • Run post-deployment checks after every release and record the results.
  • Test on real devices across screen sizes, OS versions and manufacturers.

Quality control & process

  • Write and maintain risk-based test cases, and raise clear, reproducible defects in Jira.
  • Track quality measures such as escaped defects, reopen rates and time to fix, and turn them into improvements.
  • Shape acceptance criteria with the Product Owner and engineers during refinement.
  • Support test-environment readiness and test-data management.
  • Review test cases, coach other QA engineers, and use AI tools for triage, test design and reporting.

What you will bring (non-negotiable)

  • At least 4 years in software QA, including substantial mobile app testing on iOS and Android.
  • Hands-on test automation for both mobile UI (Maestro, Appium or Detox) and APIs (REST Assured or similar), in Java or TypeScript.
  • Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Risk-based test strategy, regression planning and release sign-off.
  • Testing back-end services and integrations: APIs, webhooks and SQL databases.
  • Performance and load testing (k6, JMeter or similar).
  • Test management tools and Jira.
  • Confident, practical use of AI tools in QA work.
  • Precise written English for bug reports and release evidence, and daily work with colleagues across the Group.

Nice to have

  • Fintech, trading, payments or banking experience.
  • Release controls in a regulated environment and producing audit evidence.
  • ISTQB or equivalent certification.
  • Cloud and device-farm experience.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4–7 years of hands-on QA experience, including test automation.

Compensation & benefits

  • Base salary: €30,400 – €45,600 gross per year (€2,533 – €3,800 gross per month), before employee tax and social-security contributions.
  • Annual bonus: eligible for the Group bonus scheme
  • Pension & social security: employer contributions in line with statutory requirements.
  • Health: supplementary health insurance.
  • Annual leave: 20 working days plus public holidays.
  • Equipment & learning: company-provided hardware; annual learning and certification budget (incl. ISTQB and test-automation training).
  • Travel: occasional travel to other Group offices, paid for by the company.

Where a candidate sits within the band is determined by assessed experience against the role criteria, depth in mobile and API test automation, CI/CD and relevant financial-services exposure. The same criteria apply to any later pay progression.

How we hire

Our recruitment process is aligned with Directive (EU) 2023/970 on pay transparency and equal pay:

  • Transparent pay from the start. The salary band, bonus and benefits above apply from the first conversation. We will not offer below the published band on the basis of a candidate’s current or previous pay.
  • No salary-history questions. We will not ask about your current or previous salary at any stage, and our application form does not collect it.
  • Gender-neutral process. The job title and this description are gender-neutral, and we welcome applications from candidates of all genders and backgrounds. Interview panels are balanced wherever practicable.
  • Objective, written criteria. Shortlisting, interview scoring and the final offer within the band are made against pre-defined, written criteria, scored independently by each interviewer. The same criteria apply to later pay progression and are available on request.
  • Your rights once hired. You may discuss your own pay to exercise your right to equal pay, and you may request, in writing, information on your individual pay level and on average pay levels by sex for workers doing the same work or work of equal value, in line with applicable law.

Process at a glance: CV screen → Talent Acquisition conversation (30 min, incl. salary band) → first interview with the QA Lead and an engineer (60 min) → second round: a practical exercise covering test design, automation and AI-assisted testing (2 hours) → offer. Typical end-to-end timeline: 3–4 weeks. Reasonable adjustments are available at any stage; just let us know.

Equal opportunities and how to apply

EC Markets is an equal-opportunities employer. We make hiring decisions on the basis of skills, experience and demonstrated potential, and do not discriminate on the grounds of sex, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital or civil-partnership status, pregnancy or parental status, or trade-union membership.

Please do not include your current or previous salary: we will not use it in our decision and are not permitted to ask for it. Any personal data you share will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice and the GDPR.

Questions about the role, the salary band or reasonable adjustments are welcome at any stage; just ask the Talent Acquisition team.

job.title: EverWell - Head of Go-To-Market (Remote, NZ)
job.description:
At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 725,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://careers.evercommerce.com/us/en

About the company

Timely and SalonBiz serve over 30,000 customers in 100 countries and are on a mission to build the leading platform for beauty professionals. Together we make up EverWell, an EverCommerce vertical. Between us, we offer SaaS solutions to customers of varying sizes and stages, serving different customer profiles within the beauty industry. We’re part of the wider EverCommerce ecosystem and exist to simplify and empower the lives of business owners. We’ve got big goals and we’re ready to achieve them.


This is where you come in!

As our Head of GTM, you'll turn market opportunities and customer insights into focused growth strategies that drive qualified pipeline and new annual recurring revenue (ARR). You'll help shape where we compete, how we win and where we invest, identifying the markets, customer segments and channels that offer the greatest opportunities for growth.

Working closely with our global leaders across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships and the wider business, you'll bring teams together to turn strategy into action. You'll lead our go-to-market plans, align priorities, drive accountability and measure commercial success, while building a strong GTM capability that supports the continued growth of Timely and SalonBiz.


What you'll be doing

  • Shape our growth strategy – Identify new opportunities across markets, customer segments and channels, helping us focus on where we can make the biggest impact.
  • Turn strategy into action – Build and lead go-to-market plans with clear priorities, ownership and measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Know our customers and markets – Use customer insights, market trends and competitor intelligence to understand what matters most and where we can stand out.
  • Bring teams together – Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Product and Finance to align priorities and deliver growth initiatives.
  • Create compelling customer propositions – Help shape how we position our products, communicate their value and connect with the right customers.
  • Improve the customer journey – Identify opportunities to improve how customers discover, evaluate, purchase and get started with our products.
  • Drive commercial performance – Own the performance of our GTM initiatives, tracking pipeline, new ARR, conversion and acquisition efficiency.
  • Build and develop our GTM capability – Lead, coach and support your team while introducing better ways of working across our global markets.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who can think strategically, roll up their sleeves and bring people along with them. Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Proven experience leading go-to-market strategy, commercial growth or revenue initiatives within a SaaS business, ideally serving small and medium-sized businesses.
  • A strong track record of turning market opportunities into measurable pipeline growth and new revenue.
  • Experience building and delivering growth strategies across different markets, customer segments or channels.
  • Commercial curiosity and confidence using data, customer insights and market intelligence to make decisions.
  • A good understanding of customer value propositions, positioning and the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Strong leadership skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and bringing cross-functional teams together.
  • Experience leading and developing people, creating clear expectations and supporting high-performing teams.
  • A practical, hands-on approach. You're comfortable moving between the bigger picture and the detail needed to get things done.
  • Most importantly, you're someone who sees opportunity, knows how to turn it into action and can bring people together to deliver great results.

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in underrepresented groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single bullet point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Why join us?

At EverCommerce, we lead with inclusion and use our values to inform our decisions. We succeed together and celebrate the things that make us unique. We’re big believers in work-life balance and offer additional annual leave so you can fully switch off and relax throughout the year.

We trust our team to work where they are the most productive. You’ll have the flexibility to work from home or the office. We have office space in Auckland, Wellington, Dunedin, and provide a high-spec home office set up.

We set a high bar and support our team to innovate and focus on continuous growth. You’ll enjoy a professional development budget to fuel your growth, and an annual wellness allowance to fund the things that support your wellbeing.

  • This role is full time, permanent position and can be based anywhere in New Zealand.
  • You must be legally entitled to work in New Zealand.
  • Applications close when we find the right person!

Let us know any considerations which would enable your experience in our recruitment process to be more inclusive, such as non-traditional application formats, closed captions during video interviews, or accommodations for learning differences.



EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Company Description

Build the AI that replaces search with conversation.

AskOle is building something fundamentally different from today’s ticket exchanges, online travel agencies, and search engines.

Today, users do all the work. They search, filter, compare, open dozens of tabs, read reviews, check maps, compare hotels, look for restaurants, and try to figure out the best option.

We’re eliminating that entire experience.

A fan should simply say:

“I need two tickets for Manchester United vs Arsenal on Saturday.”

AskOle responds naturally:

“I found four excellent ticket options based on value and location. Since you’re traveling from London, would you like me to recommend hotels within walking distance of Old Trafford? I also found several restaurants that match your preferences and the best pub for pre-match atmosphere. I can book everything together in one transaction.”

That conversation replaces hundreds of clicks.

We’re looking for the Principal Architect who will build the intelligence behind that experience.

You’ll architect the AI orchestration layer that powers every AskOle conversation.

This is not another chatbot.

You’ll build a conversational commerce platform capable of understanding intent, gathering information from dozens of independent systems, reasoning over the results, ranking recommendations, asking intelligent follow-up questions, and delivering answers that feel like speaking to an expert concierge.

The platform will combine live inventory from ticket providers, hotels, airlines, restaurants, transportation, hospitality providers, maps, weather, events, reviews, and future partners into a single conversational experience.

The user never searches.

The AI does.

No pathetic AI inflated resumes or using someone else's resume

The vision is to create the first true “WeChat for football” — a platform where fans, clubs, brands, leagues, sportsbooks, creators, and merchants can communicate, transact, and engage directly inside one global environment.

Unlike traditional social media platforms, OleOle is built specifically for sports fans and designed around communication, real-time engagement, commerce, and community.

The platform combines elements of:

  • TikTok-style short-form video
  • WhatsApp-style messaging
  • live score platforms
  • programmable commerce
  • mini program ecosystems similar to WeChat

All integrated into a single football-first platform.

Communication First

Fans can communicate directly with:

  • brands
  • sportsbooks
  • creators
  • media companies
  • other fans

through follows, messaging, sharing, comments, and real-time translated conversations.

Brands can communicate directly with followers within platform communication limits designed to prevent spam and preserve user experience.

Real-Time Translation

A core component of the platform is AI-driven real-time translation across conversations, content, video, messaging, and mini programs.

The goal is to remove language barriers between global football fans and allow mini programs to operate across dozens of languages automatically.

This creates a global communication layer connecting fans, clubs, brands, and creators worldwide.

all inside one interconnected ecosystem.

Job Description Summary

As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Principal Technical Product Manager, Data & Platform owns the D&S Palantir Foundry environment and leads delivery across the technical teams that build on it and feed it. This person will own platform health, configuration, access and security markings, and ontology development for the D&S Foundry instance and the shared demonstration environment. This person will also be the program owner for 8+ platform functions (data products, platform support, predictive models, emerging technology, user-facing applications, and fleet data), managing the dependencies between them without owning the teams directly. The role also governs Foundry resources, cost, and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) capacity, and owns the platform's access model, including enrollment of external customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role. It turns the D&S data strategy set by the Chief Technology Office (CTO) into a reliable, governed platform that the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) products and our AI roadmap run on.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

Palantir Foundry Platform Ownership

  • Own platform health. Keep the D&S Foundry instance available, performant, and correctly configured, and own the platform roadmap that keeps it that way.
  • Run the demonstration environment. Keep the shared Foundry demo environment current, stable, and ready for customer-facing and leadership demonstrations on short notice.
  • Build the ontology. Drive ontology development in step with front-end work in Workshop and Contour, so the data model and the applications on top of it evolve together.
  • Manage the Palantir roadmap. Serve as the primary vendor contact for licensing, product roadmap, support escalations, and new capability adoption.

Palantir Foundry Resource, Cost, and AIP Management

  • Govern platform resources. Oversee compute allocations, ontology volumes, and storage across every Foundry usage account, and partner with the platform teams to keep resources optimized and fully visible.
  • Own cost attribution. Monitor, analyze, and manage platform consumption and cost down to the usage account, project, and ontology level, with proactive reporting and usage controls (FinOps).
  • Manage AIP capacity. Partner with Palantir to manage AIP utilization, usage thresholds, platform limits, and spend, balancing advanced AI capability against cost containment and operational stability.
  • Security, Access Governance, and B2B Enrollment
  • Own the access model. Own the Foundry security posture: design and maintain role-based access controls (RBAC), fine-grained security roles and markings, and scalable access provisioning, so every dataset and application is visible only to the people cleared to see it.
  • Control intangible exports. Define and maintain the strategy for intangible exports (export-controlled technical data shared electronically through the platform) in partnership with Export Compliance.
  • Run customer B2B enrollment. Oversee business-to-business (B2B) onboarding, identity federation, and enrollment workflows so external customers get secure, compliant multi-tenant access.

Cross-Team Platform Delivery and Dependency Management

  • Run the platform as one program. Coordinate delivery across Data Foundry, Platform Support, Insight Engines, Future Tech Labs, Digital Service Delivery, and Fleet Data Hub Support, plus the Data Flow Engine and Cloud & Solutions Design teams in the CTO organization.
  • Own the dependencies. Map, track, and resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain a single integrated view of the platform roadmap and release plan.
  • Sequence releases. Partner with Platform Support on patch and release management for the D&S Foundry instance so changes land without disrupting users.
  • Bring models into production. Work with Insight Engines to integrate predictive models, machine learning (ML), and simulations into the platform and the applications that use them.
  • Move emerging technology to the platform. Partner with Future Tech Labs to take promising technologies from evaluation and prototype to deployed capability.

Data Products and Platform Strategy

  • Translate strategy into execution. Partner with CTO Architecture & Data to turn the D&S data strategy and technical standards into the DSCX platform roadmap.
  • Centralize critical data products. Work with Data Foundry to model, secure, and publish the data products and semantic layer that DSCX applications depend on.
  • Set the data quality bar. Define data quality, lineage, and governance tagging standards for the platform, and measure against them.
  • Build the foundation for AI. Make sure the data behind TrueChoice Defense (TCD) fleet management and supply optimization, and every AI capability on the DSCX roadmap, is defined, governed, and ready to use.
  • Platform Reliability and Compliance
  • Own the escalation path. Partner with Platform Support on Level 1 through Level 3 (L1-L3) incident resolution and own escalations that cross teams.
  • Keep the platform audit-ready. Drive Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) readiness and vulnerability remediation for the D&S Foundry instance, along with data governance and audit readiness.
  • Partner on infrastructure. Work with CTO Architecture & Data, which owns the Amazon Web Services (AWS) tech stack, the Data Flow Engine, and architecture review, so platform needs are reflected in infrastructure and data delivery decisions.

Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead without authority. Align 8+ technical teams behind one platform plan through clear priorities, transparent tradeoffs, and credible follow-through.
  • Set the platform standard. Provide principal-level leadership and mentorship across the D&S Digital Technology team for data platform management.
  • Improve continuously. Use FLIGHT DECK, the GE Aerospace lean operating model, to cut toil and shorten delivery cycles. You will need to be AI experienced and know how to use AI agents to help the platform teams deliver more.

Environment

Job Description


AECOM is seeking to hire a highly skilled Senior Mechanical Engineer for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region. The ideal candidate for this position should be familiar with the tech sector, mission critical and data center industry, understanding the requirements of scale, speed, and consistency in data centers.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.  This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.  

Responsibilities, required experience, and qualifications are summarized below:

Responsibilities:

  • Data Center Heat Rejection and HVAC System Design: Developing and designing Heat Rejection and HVAC systems specifically tailored for data centers, considering factors such as type of cooling requirement as air cooled or direct fluid cooled, associated cooling loads, future flexibility of the system to accommodate variable heat distribution scenarios, phased construction and operation, airflow management, humidity control, system redundancy providing concurrent maintainability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Cooling System Selection: Selecting appropriate air/water side cooling systems for data centers, including Fan wall units, computer room air handlers (CRAHs), chilled water systems, DX systems and CRAC units, in-row cooling, and containment solutions, based on the specific cooling requirements of the data center and the criticality of the equipment.
  • Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analysis: Conducting internal CFD simulations to optimize airflow distribution, transient period analysis, identify hotspots, and ensure efficient cooling throughout the data center. Conducting external CFD on individual buildings and/or campus-wide to simulate effects of different electrical and mechanical components on each other and effects on design day selection criteria capacity of each component. For both types, prepare and/or direct preparation of models and analyse the results to recommend design modifications and optimize the Heat rejection and HVAC system performance. Coordinate the required changes and resulting effects with other trades on project.
  • Redundancy and Fault Tolerance: Designing HVAC systems with redundancy and fault-tolerant features to ensure continuous operation of the data center in the event of equipment failure or maintenance activities. This includes the design of backup cooling systems, automatic switchover mechanisms, and monitoring systems.
  • Heat Load Calculation and Capacity Planning: Performing heat load calculations for data centers to determine the cooling requirements based on the IT equipment, power density, anticipated growth, and phasing of the construction and operational steps. Conducting capacity planning to ensure the HVAC system can accommodate future expansions and upgrades. Performing HVAC loads for admin and common sections of the facility.
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability: Implementing energy-efficient HVAC design strategies, such as utilizing economizers, variable speed drives, energy recovery systems, and optimizing airflow management techniques, to minimize energy consumption and support sustainability initiatives.
  • Air Quality and Filtration: Ensuring the data center's air quality is maintained at optimal levels by designing appropriate filtration systems and implementing air quality monitoring mechanisms. Addressing concerns related to particulate matter, humidity control, and contaminant removal to protect sensitive IT equipment.
  • Coordination with Electrical and Mechanical Systems: Collaborating with electrical engineers and mechanical engineers to integrate the heat rejection and HVAC system seamlessly with the electrical infrastructure, UPS systems, emergency power systems, fire suppression systems, and other critical infrastructure components.

  • Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education. 
  • Experience in data center mechanical and electrical equipment installation and operation.
  • P. E. registration is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering, or a related field from an accredited university is typically required. Preference would be given to candidates with a master's degree or advanced coursework in HVAC systems or energy management.
  • Knowledge of data center TER Standard Topology as per Uptime Institute, TIA 942, ANSI/BICSI 002
  • Professional certifications related to HVAC engineering, such as Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Building Energy Modeling Professional (BEMP), or Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) accreditation, would be advantageous.

Job Description

Company Overview:

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!


Site Overview

We serve regional customers with our "Two sites, one team" approach, operating from OWS Doha and Dubai. We have exciting growth plans for the upcoming years and are committed to excellence in everything we do. Our team is diverse, with more than 20 different nationalities, and we celebrate different perspectives and backgrounds, which contribute to innovative solutions and a dynamic workplace. Join us and be part of a team that is dedicated to making a difference in the aerospace industry.


Role Overview

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.

At GE Aerospace Technology & Operations, our customers challenge us to tackle some of the world’s most complex engineering problems that require innovative approach using new technologies. Our engineers depend on software developers to bridge data, tools, and emerging technologies, like cloud and AI, to unlock new possibilities and shape the future of flight.

What You will Do

  • Develop technical solutions for engineers to evaluate and adopt data and AI solutions.
  • Consult on architecture, implement proof of concepts and deliver solutions for business strategic projects, including data science and machine learning systems
  • Build and present product architectures, write technical code, and demo applications to stakeholders.
  • Gain hands-on experience with the Innovator Method and turn customer insights into solution that deliver real business value
  • Sharpen your skills in cloud platforms, databases, data engineering, web design, AI technologies, and numerical methods
  • Use your strengths to support team members and build cross-functional relationships across the company.
  • Work to ship solutions to production that meet business needs and drive impact.

Our culture thrives on innovation, diversity, and deep collaboration. You’ll contribute as both a learner and a builder, helping us push the design frontier in aerospace.


Required Qualifications

  • Graduate or pursuing a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field at an accredited university or credentialed software accelerator program.
  • Minimum 3.7 cumulative GPA off a 4.0 scale without rounding
  • Strong academic performance in Computer Science or other STEM disciplines
  • Experience designing AI solutions and architecting distributed data systems
  • Proficiency in programming and debugging with Python, C#, C++, and SQL
  • Customer-centric mindset with ability to lead design thinking workshops
  • Hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Computer Vision
  • Experience building solutions using public cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
  • Preferred but not required: AWS and/or Azure certification
  • No prior work experience required

About The Internship

  • Spring: March to June
  • Location: Remote
  • Paid Internship
  • Travel Opportunities
  • Real-world project ownership
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers


At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate. ​​
